text:
alex: Rolling out v2 to canary (10% traffic) in us-east at 2026-03-12 23:00 UTC. Will monitor for model drift and header compatibility. Release notes: https://redwood.example.com/releases/v2.7.1 :rocket:

deploybot: Scheduled deploy v2.7.1 -> canary (us-east) by alex at 1765554321. Notifying on-call.

claire: Heads-up — mobile SDK teams flagged header-case sensitivity in the last v2 rollout. Can we auto-pin mobile clients to v1 for 24h if errors spike?

maria: Yes. Suggest adding a client-pin rule keyed by User-Agent prefix: `client=mobile-sdk/*` -> force v1. Ops runbook recommends 24h grace then reassess. I'll prepare the pin.

samir: If we need rollback, route-level downgrade is fastest. Quick rollback example: 
```
# rollback route mapping to v1
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/deploy/rollback -d '{"route":"/v2","to":"v1","reason":"client-pins"}'
```
Tagging on-call.

ops-oncall: I'll watch metrics. If 5xx rate for mobile route > 0.5% AND error budget consumed > 50% in 5m, trigger pin and notify @mobile-eng.

claire: Also pushing a short release-note summary to mobile-eng with schema diff + header-case note. I'll post the link in 5.

maria: Pin creation request submitted: https://intranet/redwood/pins/3345 (temporary, expires +24h).

deploybot: Canary started: v2.7.1 on 8 nodes in us-east. Health checks passing. Rolling percent: 10%.

alex: Observability queries to watch: `request_rate{route="/v2",client="mobile-sdk"}` and `log_count{level="error"} | json | header_case`.

samir: If header mismatch appears, we'll push `header_case=lower` middleware as a config-only mitigation (no binary). Prep ready.

maria: Setting a 30m tentative hold at 23:30 UTC if anomalies show. Will update this thread.

deploybot: Alert: increased 5xx on /v2 for mobile-sdk in us-east at 1765555000. Rate 0.7% over 5m. :rotating_light:

ops-oncall: Triggering client-pin to v1 now. Pin ID 3345 applied. Notified @mobile-eng. :white_check_mark:

claire: Confirmed downstream SDKs report fewer errors after the pin. Monitoring dashboards show drop in 5xx.

alex: OK — pin looks sufficient. Pausing further traffic shifts. I'll stop the rollout and hold until mobile-eng gives green.

deploybot: Rollout paused by alex at 1765555320. No further traffic increments.

maria: Filing follow-up ticket for header normalization and SDK compatibility notes. Ticket: RINF-789.

samir: Plan: after 1h, if stable, retry with header-case middleware enabled; if not, schedule full route rollback to v1.

ops-oncall: Closing immediate play; leaving pin active until mobile-eng confirms SDK patch. Reopen thread if metrics spike again. :handshake:
